what_happened: I met an account using the handle rhea_travels_22 on a dating app. We had a video call on Monday. Later that week, the person sent messages demanding money and threatening to share a video of me.
threat_and_demand: The account demanded 15000 and threatened to send the recorded video to my followers unless payment was made.

chronology.event: Had a video call with the account rhea_travels_22.
Received demand for 15000 with a UPI ID.

supporting_material_user_has: The UPI address provided for payment

missing_information.item: Exact name of the dating app
missing_information.why: Helps identify the platform service provider for reporting.

evidence_checklist.how_to_preserve: Keep the chat history intact and record full screenshots showing timestamps and usernames.
Keep record of the UPI ID and deadline without sending any money.

action_suggestions.title: Preserve messages and secure accounts
action_suggestions.why: Keep evidence before blocking, and change passwords to prevent unauthorized access.

action_suggestions.title: Report to cybercrime portal
action_suggestions.why: Prepare an official complaint using the National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal.
